text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Lithuanian border police detained three groups of 115 illegal immigrants in two days last week. They arrived from Belarus and were arrested near the Lithuanian- Polish border.
- Lithuania's Christian Democrats changed its board during its council meeting on Saturday.
- Lithuanian officials say that the scandal connected to Japanese investment company Nomura will have no negative consequences for Lithuania.
- Lithuanian Gas wants the government to increase the prices for natural gas by around 15-20 percent from July 1.
- Bank Snoras reported 4.66 million litas net profit in the first four months of 1997.
- The Lithuanian army made an effort to promote its image in a public festival on Sunday which ended with a rock concert dubbed Young people for NATO.
- Communication services in Lithuania rose by 28.7 percent during the first four months of this year.
- Lietuvos Kuras opened its fouth modern filling station on Friday.
- Foreign investors said that there is big potential on Lithuania's securities market but declined to forecast when its rise will start.
- Foreign fuel companies will try to persuade the economy ministry not to impose 15-17 percent customs duties on imported petroleum.
- The statistics department said that salaries in Lithuania rose by 416 percent during the last four years.
